description:
Console and server commands. One page of Rust console/server commands, alphabetical. Each carries `command`, `syntax`, `description`,
`category` (Rust's own ConVar namespace, e.g. `server`, `gather`), `command_type` (`command` or `variable`),
`default_value` (variables only) and `permission_required` (null when any player can run it). Cached for
30 minutes.

admin_only.description: `true` = only commands that need admin/moderator permission.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the command name, its description OR its category (so `workbench` finds every workbench ConVar).

name: search_commands
title: Console and server commands
